+"""Parse inline table2 values: comma-separated items in brackets."""
+
+from lamina.errors import ParseError
+
+
+def parse_inline_table2_value(raw: str, line: int, column: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(raw)
+    strippedText = raw.strip()
+    if not (strippedText.startswith("[") and strippedText.endswith("]")):
+        raise ParseError(f"expected [items], got {raw!r}", line, column)
+    inner = strippedText[1:-1].strip()
+    if not inner:
+        return []
+    items = [part.strip() for part in inner.split(",")]
+    if any(item == "" for item in items):
+        raise ParseError("empty item in list", line, column)
+    return items
+
+
+def _inline_table2_helper2(value):
+    from lamina.compat import normalize_v2
+
+    return normalize_v2(value)

+from lamina.parser.inline_table2 import parse_inline_table2_value
+
+
+def test_inline_table2_items():
+    assert parse_inline_table2_value("[a, b]", 1, 1) == ["a", "b"]
+
+
+def test_inline_table2_empty_list():
+    assert parse_inline_table2_value("[]", 1, 1) == []
+
+
+def test_inline_table2_rejects_bare_value():
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        parse_inline_table2_value("a, b", 2, 5)
